description: This PANGAEA collection supplies reconstructed monthly river flows for 51 stations across the island of Ireland from December 1766 to November 2016. The research team combines GR2M hydrological modelling and artificial neural networks, publishing individual reconstructions, ensemble estimates and uncertainty bounds. The repository offers the data free under CC-BY-4.0; the inspected landing page identifies a download but does not establish its internal file format. These long series can test reservoir, water-supply and hydropower simulations against extended sequences of wet and dry conditions. They complement instrumental gauge archives by estimating flow before many stations began operating. Earlier values are model reconstructions, not direct measurements, and errors in climate inputs and model stationarity propagate into the flow estimates. Monthly values cannot resolve flash-flood peaks or short operating constraints. Catchment-specific validation and the published uncertainty intervals should therefore accompany any simulation based on the reconstructed period.
